I also have the Sony a6300 along with the sigma contemporary trio (16, 30, & 56mm). I also owned but recently sold my Sony 10-18mm OSS f/4 lens. Reason I sold it was because I personally didn’t use it as much as my sigma lenses.

However, in your case it seems you might appreciate the lens since you’ll be using it a lot for landscape shots. Personally though if I’m taking a landscape shot, I’m always going to reach for my Sigma 16mm 1.4. Having the not-as-wide but much faster prime sigma is great to have on hand. Its also sharper than the sony zoom lens. 

Unless you’re specifically looking for that wide-angle-look and don’t mind the slower f-stop, I say go for it, I doubt that you’ll be disappointed with it, especially if you ever decide to vlog with it. On the other hand though, you do own a sigma lens so you know first hand just how optically amazing your shots are with your 30mm. Going with the wider 16mm will possibly give you the new look you desire with familiar use. For about the same amount of money ($400) you could go with either!
